messages:
Samira - CSM: Quick weekly check-in for Velora — token velocity + throughput snapshot. TL;DR: WoW tokens 1.2M (+18%), QoQ +43%; p50 latency 210ms (WoW +25ms), p95 540ms (WoW +70ms); error rate 0.6% (↑ from 0.2% last week); spend $6.2k (week) vs target $5.5k. Notable: mid-week spike in errors around Tue 03:15 UTC tied to a model variant fallback. Can we triage and pick immediate mitigations? :eyes:

Maria (CS): Thanks — pulling notes from account call: Velora plans to push heavier batch embedding jobs next month (expected +60% token load). They asked for cost/latency tradeoffs. I flagged autoscaling concerns.

Aj Patel: Looking into the Tue spike. Early suspicion: autoscaler delayed node provisioning on Dedicated pool due to transient low GPU availability; requests fell back to smaller model (v2-small) which increased re-tries and added p95. Stack trace snippet from logs: 
```
2026-02-17T03:15:22Z ERROR request_handler.go:412 fallback_to_variant v2-small triggered, reason: no-capacity-reservation
2026-02-17T03:15:23Z WARN kvcache.go:88 KVCacheMiss for session=x1. retry=1
2026-02-17T03:15:24Z ERROR inference_executor.go:204 OOM attempt alloc=12GB avail=9GB
```
Working on a mitigation: prefer queue/backpressure and 1-min warm pool bump for Velora during business hours.

Tyler (Product): On spend — we recommended quantized v2-medium for high-throughput endpoints. Maria, can you confirm if Velora is comfortable testing quantized variant for non-sensitive routes? Could save ~28% token-cost.

Maria (CS): Yes, they were open to a test for background embedding jobs but not for customer-facing chat. I'll book an enablement session to scope which routes are safe.

Samira - CSM: Action items: 1) Aj -> implement 1-min warm bump (owner: Aj) 2) Maria -> schedule enablement + list safe routes (owner: Maria) 3) Tyler -> prepare perf/cost comparison for v2-medium quantized (owner: Tyler). Aim: reduce p95 to <450ms and spend to <$5.8k next week.

Aj Patel: Added a temporary alert on fallback rate >0.1% and autoscaler queue depth >20 -> notify #eng-oncall + myself. Will follow-up with simulation of the warm pool bump; ETA EOD.

UsageBot: [auto] Weekly tokens graph: https://redwood-internal/charts/velora/tokens?from=2026-02-10&to=2026-02-17 — WoW +18%, QoQ +43% (embed-heavy workloads).

Samira - CSM: One more note — onboarding status: two new prod routes went live last Monday (small traffic) and accounted for ~9% of the week's token growth. Keep an eye on early ramp.

Tyler (Product): I'll prepare a short one-pager for Velora that shows toggles: batching (higher throughput, higher p50), caching (reduces tokens for prefix-heavy flows), quantization (cost). Share by Wed.

Maria (CS): Confirmed next check-in in 7 days. If Aj's warm bump stabilizes p95 we'll mark as green; otherwise escalate to Dedicated capacity review. :rocket:

Samira - CSM: Thanks team — ping here once warm-bump test is in staging.

Aj Patel: Will do — posting test results to this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
